title: The D23 replay runner is tracked and retries an arm that hit a usage limit
body:
Why: the D23 replay (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/replay.sh, unit.sh) is untracked run state; on 2026-11-11 four arms hit the Claude 5-hour limit at start (results-iface/524.K.claude.err) and produced empty patches that were silently graded until the lead noticed.
Outcome: the replay runner lives in evals/d23/ (tracked), takes OUT, IFACE and HARNESS_REF, and when claude reports a usage limit it waits until the reset and retries the arm once instead of writing an empty patch.
Proof: a test feeds a fake claude that prints 'You've hit your 5-hour limit' once and asserts the arm is retried and its patch is non-empty.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/.
